address: Jurong West 505 Market & Food Centre, #01-12, Blk 505, Jurong West Street 52, 640505, Singapore
bio: Hakkanese Lui Cha is a soupy rice dish in which chicken, cabbage and pickles meet the nuttiness of sesame and peanuts plus a hint of herbs. Order the fish cake, stuffed tofu or fried egg toppings....
